# Editable

Switch inline content between preview and validated editing states.

## Examples

### Basic

Use the smallest complete composition and let it own its initial value.

<ComponentExample component="editable" scenario="basic" title="Basic" description="Use the smallest complete composition and let it own its initial value." :index="0" />

### Validated

Reject an invalid edit while preserving the last accepted value.

<ComponentExample component="editable" scenario="validated" title="Validated" description="Reject an invalid edit while preserving the last accepted value." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Start editing from the preview, or commit a single-line draft. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancel editing and restore the accepted value. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move through the preview, input, and explicit action controls. |

## Accessibility

Preview and input states remain distinguishable; invalid drafts are announced on the real input.
